title.en: Tale 1 — The Philosopher and the King

sentences.en: There was a king named Dabshalim.

sentences.ar: صار ظالم وما حدا بيقدر يحكي معه.
sentences.en: He became unjust and nobody could speak with him.

sentences.ar: فيلسوف اسمه بيدبا قرر يروح لعنده.
sentences.en: A philosopher named Bidpai decided to go to him.
His friends said to him: he will kill you.
He said: I will speak to him another way.

sentences.ar: وقف قدام الملك وحكى له قصة حيوانات.
sentences.en: He stood before the king and told him a story about animals.

sentences.ar: الملك سمع وما زعل، لأن القصة مش عنه.
sentences.en: The king listened and was not angry, because the story was not about him.
And then he understood that it was.
